title.narrative: Integrated Residential Hostel and Skill Development Initiative for Underprivileged Children

description.narrative: National Scouts and Guide Organization (NSGO India) is a premier registered institution aligned with NITI Aayog, Government of India. This mega initiative focuses on establishing dedicated residential hostels, safe habitats, and advanced skill training centers for underprivileged and marginalized youth across India.NSGO India holds unmatched national and global trust, being registered and recognized by over 10+ Ministries of the Government of India, including the Ministry of Commerce & Industry (BHASKAR ID: OI-0426-9451WN), Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports (MY Bharat ID: MBP74239407), and Skill India MSDE (TP ID: TP354421).At the international level, the organization maintains peak compliance as a verified partner of the U.S. Federal Government (SAM.gov UEI: WTYGJF9A3W25), United Nations DESA, UNGM, and a certified NATO NSPA associate (NCAGE Code: 7993Y). This project aims to leverage this comprehensive network to scale grassroots youth empowerment and holistic social welfare
